name: Margaret Thatcher
summary: Creative and detail-oriented UI-UX Designer with over 5 years of experience in creating user-centric designs for high-traffic websites and mobile applications. Adept at transforming complex concepts into user-friendly experiences. Passionate about enhancing user satisfaction and engagement through intuitive design solutions.

description: Led the redesign of the company's main product, resulting in a 30% increase in user engagement.
Conducted user research and usability testing with over 100 users to inform design decisions.
Collaborated with developers to ensure design feasibility and proper implementation.
Designed user interfaces for various mobile applications that improved user retention rates by 25%.
Created wireframes and prototypes for client presentations, ensuring alignment with user needs.
Worked closely with product managers to define customer journeys and interface solutions.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Redesign of eCommerce platform increasing conversion rates by 15%.
Developed a mobile application for a local charity focusing on ease of use and accessibility.
